//_2: IMPORTANT: config.json is MANAGED AUTOMATICALLY by the Copilot CLI. Do not hand-edit the caches/flights. Your editable USER settings belong in ~/.copilot/settings.json instead.
//_3: The few fields below are the ones you may reasonably want to seed on a new machine. The CLI will add/refresh the rest itself.
//_lastUser: Which host/account the CLI logs in as.
//_trusted: Folders the CLI treats as trusted (skips the trust prompt). Add absolute paths you work in. Keep this list tight for safety.
//_models: Recently used model ids (the CLI maintains this; seeding is optional).
